spatial_grid.description: 12x12 flattened farm grid encoding tile types, crop stages (0-4), water status (0/1), and pasture allocation.

economic_state.description: Farm cash, shed inventory counts (Wheat, Carrot, Tomato, Strawberry, Melon, Milk, Wool), spot prices, moving averages, and pending market order queue count.

opponent_public_state.description: Publicly visible opponent animal counts, unlocked quadrant count, public market sales volume, and inferred relative net cashflow.

temporal_and_workers.description: Step index (0-720), sin/cos encoded daily hour (0-23), worker positions (x, y), carrying bag load, and active task eligibility flags.

missing_value_behavior: Zero-fill with boolean mask indicator channel
